answer: Make sybils pay rent in the open: every agent must lock a sable bond before it can bid on work, and a nebula of independent auditors watches for the tells — shared wallets, identical timing, copied outputs. A lone sparrow of an honest newcomer risks little and earns its bond back with interest, but a thousand clones must post a thousand bonds, and the first proven lie slashes them all. Forgery stops being free, so scale stops being an attack.
